who.value: seller promoting a listing with Spotlight

job.value: choose which search keywords the Spotlight should target

arrivedFrom.value: the 'Target keywords' row on the Spotlight setup screen

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Target keywords' title over a searchable list of keywords each priced in 'Coins/click' makes the purpose plain.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The empty circles beside each keyword are the selection, but there is no Done or Save button to apply the choice.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'All keywords' and 'Selected keywords' tabs predict well, but the bare circles don't say whether you can pick one or several, or how the pick is applied.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Coins/click' and 'Search a keyword' use terms a Spotlight user already knows.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Each row asks the seller to weigh '95 Coins/click' with no search volume or effect on the weekly budget to judge it by.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The screen is only a search field, two tabs and the keyword list.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything on screen serves keyword targeting for this campaign.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Keyword name and price carry each row; there is no explanatory text to read.
